boards.hardware: ESP32-S3R8, 8 MB octal PSRAM, 32 MB flash; 466x466 CO5300 QSPI AMOLED; CST9217 touch; ES8311 speaker codec and NS4150B amplifier; ES7210 dual microphones; shared audio MCLK GPIO16; AXP2101 power management; QMI8658 IMU
boards.identify: Waveshare 1.75C badge-style metal enclosure, BOOT and PWR buttons, native USB-C, 32 MB flash. Not the non-C 1.75 or -B board.
boards.flash_port: USB-C native ESP32-S3 USB. Hold BOOT while resetting if recovery is needed.
boards.use: Standalone WiFi voice; BOOT call controls, swipe-left app launcher, Chinese/English settings and ESP-NOW nearby discovery, mutual pairing and greetings
boards.notes: Hardware corrected to the C variant. Existing profile names and firmware model are retained for installed-device/OTA compatibility. Product ID remains 10. Use waveshare-amoled-175-wifi. Hotspot Amoled175-XXXX. Product esp32-s3-touch-amoled-175 (id 10), supplied by the developer. Short-press BOOT to start/end the selected call. Swipe left for apps and right to return. Settings includes WiFi status and persistent Chinese/English choice. Nearby mode pauses cloud WiFi, pairs two compatible devices after both confirm matching codes, supports acknowledged greetings and restores WiFi on exit. Delete/reset require confirmation. Two-device radio acceptance pending.
